hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: If the sum of all elements is strictly less than target, the target can never be formed.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Sort available powers of two in descending order and greedily use the largest values whenever possible.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: When an exact power of two is missing, break the smallest available larger power into halves, counting each split as an operation.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Bitwise greedy decomposition with power-of-two splits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: General knapsack recursion blows up when target values reach 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency array for 32 bit levels uses constant space.
